newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ares-Serono appoints Theurillat as CFO.
newsitem.headline: Ares-Serono appoints Theurillat as CFO.

text.p: Swiss pharmaceuticals group Ares-Serono said Jacques Theurillat has been appointed chief financial officer, succeeding Hans Tierstein, 65, who retires.
Ares-Serono said in a statement that Tierstein, who has been CFO since 1980, will continue to serve as chairman and belong to the company's management team as senior financial advisor.
Theurillat, 37, has been associated with Ares-Serono for 11 years and most recently he was managing director of Istituto Farmacologico Serono in Rome.
